data.body: CI-lock fact for the `.github/complexity-baseline.json` re-spell (step 10 of the Approach): the `Complexity-baseline lock` step in `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml` runs `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --lock`, which diffs this change's baseline against main's copy at the merge base and rejects ANY added key (`lock_against_base`, `scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py:488-511`: "NEW entry added ... an administrator must override the gate"). A path re-spell is a removed key plus an added key, so the lock cannot distinguish it from a smuggled new ceiling and will vote `Verified -1` on this change even though `make lint` (`--check`) and `tests/unit/test_complexity_baseline.py` pass locally. Landing therefore requires the override the lock was designed with (task 47e9): an administrator force-submit of this one change after confirming the lock step is the only red item in its CI run. Agents must not perform that override; the session owner escalates it to the operator. Alternatives considered and rejected: reducing the six functions under the threshold inside a move story (not behaviour-preserving), and teaching the lock about renames (a gate redesign for a one-time move).
